summary.text: Christine Dargon is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Mark Finchem.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a college professor and community organizer from Rimrock who is running as a Clean Elections candidate.

paragraphs.text: Christine Dargon earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Connecticut in 1992, a graduate degree from Fordham University in 1994, and a Ph.D. from Seton Hall University in 1999.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in Connecticut, has lived in Rimrock, Arizona, since 2010, and has taught college psychology since 1997.
She said she co-founded Indivisible Rimrock, served as a Yavapai County precinct committeewoman, and organized with Red for Ed.
Dargon advanced from the Democratic primary for District 1 on July 21, 2026.
She listed protecting Arizona's water future, fully funding public education, expanding rural healthcare access and making housing more affordable among her priorities.
